confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are medium confidence. They are based on crowd-sourced Numbeo figures, 2026 travel-budget averages, and a few travel-blog and price-index snapshots that disagree by about 10 to 30 percent, and no source is dated specifically to July 2026. Cocktail and wine are low confidence: cocktail is set at about 2.5 times the beer anchor and wine_glass is inferred from the Numbeo mid-range bottle price, since no direct Cebu cocktail or glass price was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Cebu City lodging tiers, with no accommodation search and no inspection of live booking pages, so they are low confidence. PHP-to-USD conversion assumes about 58 PHP per USD, which was not sourced from a current rate. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure visible in a search-result snapshot of the RBA exchange-rates page (20 March 2026). I could not open the RBA page or confirm it is the latest observation as of 2026-10-16, so it may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against Cebu City's own published price-index and travel-budget sources for food and drink, with a basic check against other Philippine urban centres. Accommodation tiers are benchmarked to general knowledge of Philippine mid-sized city lodging, not to Cebu-specific listings.
